h1: WordPress integrations that fit your business
overview: We connect your WordPress site to the tools you already use, so leads and orders land in the right place without copying by hand. That can be a contact form feeding your CRM, signups going to your email list, a booking calendar, or payments through Stripe or PayPal. We set it up in your own accounts, test with real entries and write down how it works.

faq: HubSpot, Mailchimp, Klaviyo, ConvertKit, Calendly, Stripe, PayPal, Google Sheets and many others through plugins, their APIs or an automation tool. Send your list and we confirm.
Do I need paid plans for those tools?
Sometimes. We tell you before we start. Tool subscriptions are billed by the providers directly to you, and we use free tiers wherever they do the job.
Is collecting emails on forms compliant?
We add clear consent wording and a checkbox where needed, and follow the tool's rules. You stay responsible for your own legal obligations, and we suggest you check them with an advisor.
What if a connection stops working later?
We add an error alert on Premium so you hear about it quickly. Fixing it after the 14 days can be a small extra order or part of a maintenance sprint.
